violet.name: Violet Sorrengail
violet.description: Raised among books and destined to be a scribe, Violet finds herself training to become a dragon rider. She faces a brutal new world with a sharp mind and the determination to forge her own path.
violet.strengthDetail: She notices details and finds unexpected solutions.
violet.vulnerabilityDetail: She can push beyond her limits and resist help.

rhysand.name: Rhysand
rhysand.description: Behind a teasing smile and an unreadable manner, Rhysand keeps his intentions close. He meets a dangerous world with sharp wit and a fierce instinct to protect those he values.
rhysand.strengthDetail: He reads a situation carefully before making his move.
rhysand.vulnerabilityDetail: Protecting others can mean keeping them at a distance.

azriel.name: Azriel
azriel.description: Quiet and watchful, Azriel tends to listen before he speaks. His restrained manner hides a deeply loyal nature and an eye for what others miss.
azriel.strengthDetail: He pays attention to the smallest details.
azriel.vulnerabilityDetail: His silence can make it difficult to let others in.

feyre.name: Feyre
feyre.description: A huntress with an artist’s eye, Feyre has learned to survive by looking after others. Beneath her practical instincts is a longing for beauty and a life she can choose for herself.
feyre.strengthDetail: She keeps finding a way forward in unfamiliar places.
feyre.vulnerabilityDetail: Responsibility can make it hard to accept care in return.

nesta.name: Nesta
nesta.description: Nesta meets the world with a sharp tongue and a guarded heart. Fiercely independent, she is slow to offer trust and unwilling to pretend that difficult feelings are simple.
nesta.strengthDetail: When she commits, she does so wholeheartedly.
nesta.vulnerabilityDetail: Her defensive edges can keep support out, too.

cassian.name: Cassian
cassian.description: A warrior with a ready laugh, Cassian brings warmth as well as strength to the people around him. Beneath his easy confidence is a serious commitment to those he protects.
cassian.strengthDetail: He faces challenges head-on and helps others do the same.
cassian.vulnerabilityDetail: Being the strong one can leave little room for his own doubts.

aelin.name: Aelin / Celaena
aelin.description: A skilled assassin with a taste for books, music and beautiful things, Celaena refuses to be defined only by survival. Wit and defiance are as much a part of her as discipline.
aelin.strengthDetail: She looks for possibilities even when the odds are against her.
aelin.vulnerabilityDetail: Pride and protectiveness can make sharing a burden difficult.

rowan.name: Rowan
rowan.description: An experienced Fae warrior, Rowan values discipline, honesty and actions over easy words. His stern manner leaves little doubt about the standards he sets for himself and others.
rowan.strengthDetail: He stays focused when a situation demands a clear head.
rowan.vulnerabilityDetail: A guarded manner can make trust slow to grow.

poppy.name: Poppy
poppy.description: Sheltered by rules and expectations, Poppy is full of questions about the world beyond them. Her compassion and curiosity sit alongside a growing desire to make choices of her own.
poppy.strengthDetail: She questions what she is told and cares deeply about others.
poppy.vulnerabilityDetail: A sheltered life can make unfamiliar intentions hard to read.

casteel.name: Casteel
casteel.description: Casteel has an easy confidence, a quick wit and a habit of revealing only what he chooses. His playful manner sits alongside a determined and protective streak.
casteel.strengthDetail: He adapts quickly and rarely loses his nerve.
casteel.vulnerabilityDetail: Secrecy can complicate the trust he hopes to build.

katniss.name: Katniss Everdeen
katniss.description: A hunter from District 12, Katniss is used to providing for her family. Practical and wary, she expresses her love through action and meets danger with a powerful instinct to protect.
katniss.strengthDetail: She acts decisively when someone she loves is at risk.
katniss.vulnerabilityDetail: Self-reliance can make accepting help feel dangerous.

peeta.name: Peeta Mellark
peeta.description: A baker’s son with an artist’s touch, Peeta notices people as carefully as he notices colour. Kindness and a gift for words give him a quiet strength in a harsh world.
peeta.strengthDetail: He understands how words can comfort, connect and persuade.
peeta.vulnerabilityDetail: His willingness to protect can come at his own expense.

xaden.name: Xaden Riorson
xaden.description: A formidable wingleader at Basgiath, Xaden commands attention without offering easy explanations. His controlled exterior and sharp judgement make him difficult to read.
xaden.strengthDetail: He assesses danger quickly and acts with purpose.
xaden.vulnerabilityDetail: Protectiveness and secrecy can make openness difficult.

ron.name: Ron Weasley
ron.description: Growing up in a large wizarding family has given Ron humour, warmth and a keen sense of friendship. He may doubt himself, but his courage often appears exactly when it is needed.
ron.strengthDetail: He brings heart, humour and a talent for chess to a challenge.
ron.vulnerabilityDetail: Comparisons with others can shake his confidence.

hedwig.name: Hedwig
hedwig.description: Harry’s snowy owl is both a messenger and a familiar presence in an unfamiliar world. Proud and expressive, she has a clear sense of how she expects to be treated.
hedwig.strengthDetail: She offers a reassuring link to the people Harry cares about.
hedwig.vulnerabilityDetail: She makes her displeasure clear when she feels neglected.

crookshanks.name: Crookshanks
crookshanks.description: Hermione’s shaggy ginger cat is watchful, independent and not easily fooled. His grumpy appearance gives little away about the attention he pays to his surroundings.
crookshanks.strengthDetail: He notices things that the people around him can overlook.
crookshanks.vulnerabilityDetail: His determined behaviour does not always make sense to others.

fleetfoot.name: Fleetfoot
fleetfoot.description: An affectionate dog in the world of Throne of Glass, Fleetfoot brings warmth to a story full of danger. Her presence is a reminder that companionship can be a kind of comfort.
fleetfoot.strengthDetail: She brings an uncomplicated affection to those around her.
fleetfoot.vulnerabilityDetail: Like any beloved companion, she needs care and protection.

abraxos.name: Abraxos
abraxos.description: A wyvern whose gentle curiosity challenges first impressions, Abraxos has a distinctive spirit. There is more to him than the fearsome creature others expect to see.
abraxos.strengthDetail: He keeps going and responds with unexpected sensitivity.
abraxos.vulnerabilityDetail: Others can mistake a gentle nature for weakness.

tairn.name: Tairn
tairn.description: An imposing black dragon with little patience for foolishness, Tairn has a forceful presence and a dry edge to his judgement. Earning his respect is no small thing.
tairn.strengthDetail: He recognises resolve and does not confuse it with appearances.
tairn.vulnerabilityDetail: His standards leave little room for hesitation or excuses.

andarna.name: Andarna
andarna.description: A small golden dragon with a curious and spirited nature, Andarna is eager to engage with the world. Her warmth sits alongside a strong wish to make her own choices.
andarna.strengthDetail: She approaches the unfamiliar with enthusiasm.
andarna.vulnerabilityDetail: Her eagerness can run ahead of the protection she still needs.

sgaeyl.name: Sgaeyl
sgaeyl.description: A blue dragon with a commanding presence, Sgaeyl is watchful, exacting and difficult to intimidate. Her independence makes clear that her trust must be earned.
sgaeyl.strengthDetail: She meets danger with a clear and unwavering purpose.
sgaeyl.vulnerabilityDetail: Her formidable presence leaves little space for easy familiarity.

buttercup.name: Buttercup
buttercup.description: Prim’s scruffy cat has a suspicious gaze and a stubborn streak. Far from an immediately charming companion, he has his own ways of showing where he belongs.
buttercup.strengthDetail: He is tougher and more enduring than he first appears.
buttercup.vulnerabilityDetail: Trust and affection do not come easily to him.
